_readme: This is what the coach-judge skill writes automatically to <bundle>/judgement.json. You don't hand-write this — it's here so the format is inspectable without running the skill. Delete this key if you ever hand-edit a real one, which you shouldn't need to.

harness-is-substantive.justification: AGENTS.md names the actual stack (FastAPI + SQLModel) and two real rules — 'every mutating endpoint requires an idempotency key' and 'never write to the ledger table outside services/ledger.py' — that couldn't have come from a template. Loses a point because the testing section is still generic advice ('write tests for new behaviour') rather than this project's own conventions.

iterative-direction.justification: The team's second prompt narrowed 'build the booking flow' from the first prompt down to 'just the availability check, we'll wire payment after' — a real decision, not a restatement. Prompts throughout the session read as a sequence of scoped asks rather than one large spec.
